queries: WITH race_avg AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_points) AS avg_points, AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_avg GROUP BY country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_avg) AS avg_wins_minus_mean FROM country_avg

WITH race_avg AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.circuitId, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM races r JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, r.circuitId), country_avg AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(ra.avg_points) AS avg_points, AVG(ra.avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM circuits c LEFT JOIN race_avg ra ON ra.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_avg) AS wins_minus_mean FROM country_avg

assumptions.assumption: Races with no constructorStandings rows are excluded, so they do not count as a race for their country. Countries with no such races are therefore omitted.
The simple mean of countries' average wins is taken over the countries returned, each counted once.

assumptions.assumption: Each race's figure is the plain average of constructorStandings.points and .wins over all constructor rows for that race. These are season-to-date values taken as stored. Races with no standings rows contribute nothing.
Every country with a circuit is returned, including any whose races have no standings rows (NULL averages). The overall mean is taken over the countries that have a non-NULL average wins value.

responses.sql: WITH race_avg AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_points) AS avg_points, AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_avg GROUP BY country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_avg) AS avg_wins_minus_mean FROM country_avg

assumptions.assumption: Countries come from circuits joined to races. A country counts only if a circuit there has held a race. A country whose races have no constructor standings is still returned, with NULL averages. It is skipped in the overall mean.
The simple mean of countries' average wins is taken over countries with a non-NULL average wins value, each country counted once.
